svg.text: SI CONSOLE
03 POWER DIAGRAM
REV R3 | DATE 2026-11-23
DRAFT REFERENCE, NOT FOR SUBMISSION
Wall, 27W PSU, Pi, USB loads, monitor on own supply, headroom.
POWER FLOW, WALL TO PI TO USB LOADS. MONITOR ON ITS OWN SUPPLY.
WALL
120V CA / 220V CN
50/60 Hz, Type A / I
Plug adapter only
27W PSU
Raspberry Pi 27W USB-C
Official PSU only.
PI 5
Raspberry Pi 5 8GB
Idle about 4.84W ASSUMED
Typ 11.9W, peak 19.4W
USB LOADS
See table below
Total peak 0.60A
Limit 1.6A. Headroom 1.00A.
MONITOR
MSI MP165 E6, separate
10W max, 15W PD
Own 20W brick. Never from Pi.
USB CURRENT BUDGET, PI USB LIMIT 1.6A WITH OFFICIAL 27W PSU
Mini screen 5 inch HDMI (H) | 0.00 A on Pi USB | 0.00 A peak | Own USB charger, NOT Pi USB, Rev R2.1. Frees 0.40 A.
FIFINE AM8 mic | 0.10 A typ | 0.10 A peak | USB, ASSUMED
USB soundbar | 0.10 A typ | 0.50 A peak | USB audio + power, ASSUMED max, not measured
TOTAL USB | 0.20 A typ | 0.60 A peak | HEADROOM 1.00 A at peak. Comfortable.
LEDs 6x via ULN2003, 5V rail | 0.06 A | 0.08 A max | Not USB. From Pi 5V rail, not GPIO.
5V case fan, 40 mm | 0.14 A | 0.14 A | From Pi 5V rail, not USB. Rear wall exhaust high.
Pi board + microSD + cooler | about 2.0 A typ | about 3.9 A peak | At 5V. PSU 5A. Headroom about 1.1A.
HEADROOM BAR, USB PEAK: [######------------] 0.60 / 1.60 A used, 1.00 A left. ASSUMED loads, test on real hardware.
If a 15W supply at 5V 3A is used instead, USB limit drops to 0.60 A. That will brown out. Do not use it.
Whole system wall, microSD build: typ about 20W, peak about 30-33W. Monitor separate: 7W typ, 10W max.
MONITOR POWER, SEPARATE PATH
Wall 120/220V - Amazon Basics 20W USB-C brick, 5V 3A, CAD 15.26 LIKELY - MSI MP165 E6 USB-C in.
MSI draws 10W max, 1.4A typ, 2.0A peak at 5V. That alone exceeds the Pi 1.6A USB limit. Never power it from Pi.
Test: unplug monitor power while Pi runs. Pi must not reboot. If it does, monitor was drawing from Pi.
CHECKS
vcgencmd get_throttled must be 0x0 after 10 min, and after 30 min full load. If not 0x0, reduce USB load.
Brownout signs: lightning icon, Wi-Fi drops, USB disconnect, random reboot, microSD corruption.
China: 220V 50 Hz, Type A and Type I. Pi PSU takes 100-240V, no converter, plug adapter only. VERIFIED.
No lithium battery anywhere. Wall power only. Spare official PSU CAD 16.95 VERIFIED, pack if budget allows.
Do not use NVMe for booth build. NVMe peak about 23.9W, about 4.8A at 5V, 96 percent of 5A limit. Use microSD.
ASSUMPTIONS
* USB currents for mic and soundbar are ASSUMED, not measured on these exact parts. Soundbar 0.5 A max is a planning number, measure with a USB meter.
* Pi idle 4.84W and typ 11.9W / peak 19.4W are from previous blueprint, LIKELY, not measured in this build.
* Mini screen is NOT on Pi USB in Rev R2.1. It has its own USB charger. The old 1.50 A peak and 0.10 A headroom are stale, do not use them.
* Monitor 10W max and 1.4A typ / 2.0A peak are from previous blueprint, LIKELY.
* Wall totals 20W typ / 30-33W peak are LIKELY, efficiency about 89 percent ASSUMED.
